newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Abidjan bourse closes higher, lifted by brewer.
newsitem.headline: Abidjan bourse closes higher, lifted by brewer.

text.p: Brewery company SOLIBRA, the top performer on Ivory Coast's bourse this week, helped push the two share indices higher on Friday, the Bourse's market report showed.

The BVA All-Share Index rose 0.94 percent to 363.17 points, taking the cumulative rise for 1996 to 30.99 percent. The 12VB 12-share index rose 1.67 percent to a record 251.85 points, taking the 1996 rise to 26.39 percent.

SOLIBRA (+4,520 CFA francs to 61,000 CFA) led risers, followed by textile company UNIWAX (+2,910 CFA to 59,010), NESTLE-CI (+2,680 CFA to 56,330), ELF OIL-CI (+2,540 CFA to 27,330) and tobacco company SITAB (+2,130 CFA to 46,800).
Turnover rose to 10,297 shares traded compared with 5,133 the previous week. The value of shares traded was far higher -- 173,701,000 CFA compared with 90,634,000 CFA.
The BVA index stood at 277.25 points at the end of 1995, the 12VB at 199.26 points.
The Abidjan bourse recorded a 78.57 percent rise in market capitalisation to 400 billion CFA in 1995.
